1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) that is __cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus __derived from a non-pestiviral source or obtained through a specific attenuation process distinct from naturally occurring cytopathic variants__.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the BVDV-lb is present in a ratio of at least 2:1 relative to other viral components__.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the BVDV-lb comprises at least 50% of the total viral load__.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen __that is not derived from Leptospira__.

7. (Original) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __and is not a bacterial culture__.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen __that is not derived from Leptospira__.
